population_note_text: Books population (optional, cancelled and post-dated vouchers excluded). A capital-ledger line is excluded from the daily-balance walk, and counted as interest/remuneration credited instead, iff that SAME voucher also carries a line on the partner's own interest or remuneration ledger -- identified from the voucher's other lines, never from a date, number or narration.

figures.definition_text: Whether s.40(b)/s.194T apply to this engagement: read from rules.entity(...).s40b_interest_rate_bp and rules.entity(...).s194t for this engagement's entity_type -- never from the entity_type string itself. 'no' when both are absent/zero/false.
Deed interest rate not available; rules.s40b_interest_rate_bp used as an upper bound (1200 bp), not a confirmed authorised rate.
Sum of interest_credited_<partner> across all partners -- cross-check this against a shared interest_ledger's own TB movement when every partner uses the same ledger name.

figures.value: not computed: no partner is configured for this firm
figures.definition_text: The sum of the s.40(b) excess across the firm's partners is not stated: it would leave out the partners whose excess is not computed (their s40b_not_computed findings), or no partner is configured (see that question). Where a partner's excess is computed, it is that partner's own figure.

findings.title_text: Partnership deed not received; s.40(b) interest rate assumed at the statutory cap
limits_text: s.40(b) allows interest only as authorised by, and not exceeding the amount specified in, the partnership deed; without the deed the actual authorised rate is unknown, so the statutory cap (1200 bp) is used here as an upper bound on allowable interest, not a confirmed rate.
ask_client_text: Provide the partnership deed (and any supplementary deed in force during the year) showing the authorised interest rate and remuneration clause.

findings.title_text: No partner is configured for this firm: s.40(b) interest and s.194T are not computed
limits_text: s.40(b) and s.194T apply to this entity, but the client's configuration names no partner, so no partner's capital, interest or remuneration is read. No excess is stated, and none is listed in clause 21(c).
ask_client_text: The partners, and for each the capital, interest and remuneration ledgers.
